source: Quest Helper plugin (github.com/Zoinkwiz/quest-helper) commit b9b93706618a7b7fe7e5ea30e9a9ef35ba09673e; routes and dialogue checked against the OSRS Wiki quest guides (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), November 2026

rewards: Ability to clean specimens in the Varrock Museum

st.t: Talk to an Examiner in the Exam Centre south east of Varrock.
Talk to Curator Haig in the Varrock Museum.
Return to an Examiner in the Exam Centre south east of Varrock.
Go to the hilltop north of the Exam Centre with the blue urn. Search the second bush east of the urn for a teddy.
Pick up the tray in the south east of the dig site.
Long-press the cup of tea, choose Use, then tap the Panning Guide nearby.
Pan at a panning point in the river, then search the full panning tray. Repeat until you find a special cup.
Pickpocket workmen until you get an animal skull and a specimen brush.
Talk to the female student in the north west of the Digsite with the teddy in your inventory.
Talk to the female student again to get her exam answer.
Talk to the student in an orange shirt in the north east of the Digsite with the special cup in your inventory.
Talk to the student in an orange shirt again to get his exam answer.
Talk to the student in a green shirt in the south of the Digsite with the animal skull in your inventory.
Talk to the student in a green shirt again to get his exam answer.
Talk to an Examiner in the Exam Centre to take the first test.
s: The study of the earth, its contents and history.
All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.
Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.

st.t: Talk to the female student in the north west of the Digsite.
Talk to the student in an orange shirt in the north east of the Digsite.
Talk to the student in a green shirt in the south of the Digsite.
Talk to an Examiner in the Exam Centre to take the second test.
s: I am ready for the next exam.
Samples taken in rough form; kept only in sealed containers.
Finds must be carefully handled, and gloves worn.
Always handle with care; strike cleanly on its cleaving point.

st.t: Talk to the female student in the north west of the Digsite.
Talk to the female student again.
Talk to the student in an orange shirt in the north east of the Digsite.
Talk to the student in a green shirt in the south of the Digsite.
Talk to an Examiner in the Exam Centre to take the third test.
s: I am ready for the last exam...
Samples cleaned, and carried only in specimen jars.
Brush carefully and slowly using short strokes.
Handle bones very carefully and keep them away from other samples.

st.t: Search the cupboard on the south wall of the west room of the Exam Centre for a specimen jar.
Dig in the north east dig spot in the Digsite until you get a talisman.
Talk to the Archaeological expert in the Exam Centre.
Use the invitation letter on a Digsite workman you can pickpocket. The workman by the west winch won't take it. If you lost the letter, ask the Archaeological expert in the Exam Centre for another.
s: I lost the letter you gave me.

st.t: Use a rope on the west winch.
Climb down the west winch.
Pick up some arcenia root, just north of the rope.
Search the bricks to the east of the rope.
Climb back to the surface.
Use a rope on the north east winch.
Climb down the north east winch.
Talk to Doug Deeping.
s: How could I move a large pile of rocks?

st.t: Leave Doug's cave.
Use the key on the chest in the tent in the south of the Digsite.
Search the chest.
Use a trowel on the centre barrel just west of the chest's tent.
Use a vial on the barrel west of the chest's tent.
Don't just tap the liquid, or you'll empty it. Long-press the unidentified liquid, choose Use, then tap the Archaeological expert in the Exam Centre.
Use the powder on the Archaeological expert in the Exam Centre.
Mix the nitroglycerin and ammonium nitrate together.
Grind charcoal with a pestle and mortar.
Add the ground charcoal to the vial.
Add arcenia root to the vial.
Climb down the rope on the west winch.
Use the compound on the bricks to the east of the rope, not on the rocks.
Use a tinderbox on the bricks to the east of the rope.
Take the stone tablet in the south room.
Use the tablet on the Archaeological expert in the Exam Centre to complete the quest.
